indicators.name: Real manufacturing GVA growth
indicators.definition: Annual percentage change in real Gross Value Added of manufacturing at constant prices in the current National Accounts series.
indicators.calculation_method: Use the source-defined annual real manufacturing GVA growth rate. Do not recompute from mixed-vintage levels without recording the vintage and base series.

version_history.definition: Annual percentage change in real manufacturing GVA using the current National Accounts series.
version_history.numerator: current-period real manufacturing GVA minus prior-period real manufacturing GVA
version_history.methodology: MoSPI National Accounts methodology, current base 2022-23
version_history.comparability_status: Use source-defined current-series back-series and preserve revisions.

indicators.name: Manufacturing share of GVA
indicators.definition: Manufacturing GVA as a percentage of total GVA for the same reference period and price basis.
indicators.calculation_method: Manufacturing GVA / total GVA * 100, using the same NAS vintage, price basis and reference period for numerator and denominator.

version_history.definition: Manufacturing GVA divided by total GVA for the same period and price basis.
version_history.methodology: Derived from MoSPI National Accounts series.
version_history.comparability_status: Derived metric; preserve NAS revisions and price basis.

indicators.name: Manufacturing Index of Industrial Production
indicators.definition: Monthly manufacturing sector index measuring changes in the volume of production relative to the IIP base period.
indicators.calculation_method: Use the MoSPI published manufacturing sector IIP index. Preserve quick estimate, revised and final vintages separately.

version_history.definition: Manufacturing sector IIP under the new 2022-23 base series.
version_history.methodology: MoSPI IIP new series, base 2022-23, NIC 2008 classification.
version_history.comparability_status: Do not silently splice with the superseded 2011-12 series. Latest observation is provisional and prior observations are subject to revision.

indicators.name: Registered manufacturing GVA
indicators.definition: Gross Value Added reported for factories covered by the Annual Survey of Industries, at the published national or State aggregation level.

baseline.availability: ASI historical releases subject to series coverage

indicators.calculation_method: Use published ASI GVA aggregate for the selected geography and reference year. Do not treat ASI GVA as total manufacturing GVA because ASI covers registered organised manufacturing.

version_history.definition: Published ASI gross value added for registered organised manufacturing factories.
version_history.methodology: MoSPI Annual Survey of Industries methodology.
version_history.comparability_status: Coverage is registered organised manufacturing; retain ASI methodology and coverage notes.

indicators.name: Registered manufacturing persons engaged
indicators.definition: Total persons engaged in factories covered by the Annual Survey of Industries, at the published national or State aggregation level.

baseline.availability: ASI historical releases subject to series coverage

indicators.calculation_method: Use published ASI persons-engaged aggregate for the selected geography and reference year.

version_history.definition: Total persons engaged in ASI-covered factories.
version_history.methodology: MoSPI Annual Survey of Industries methodology and published summary tables.
version_history.comparability_status: Registered organised manufacturing only; not a measure of total manufacturing employment.

indicators.name: Manufacturing share of workers
indicators.definition: Share of workers classified in manufacturing industry divisions 10-33 under NIC 2008 among workers measured by the specified PLFS activity-status concept.
indicators.calculation_method: Use PLFS published industry-of-work estimates for NIC 2008 manufacturing divisions 10-33. Preserve the activity-status concept and survey design for each vintage.

version_history.definition: PLFS worker share associated with manufacturing industry divisions 10-33 under the specified PLFS concept.
version_history.numerator: workers in manufacturing divisions 10-33 under the specified PLFS concept
version_history.denominator: workers in the same PLFS universe
version_history.methodology: PLFS annual survey concepts, NIC 2008 industry classification for the historical series.
version_history.comparability_status: Review the 2025 sampling-design change before comparing post-2025 estimates with earlier annual estimates.

indicators.name: Manufacturing value added, international comparison
indicators.definition: Manufacturing value added reported by UNIDO for the manufacturing sector under ISIC Revision 4, using the country-year observation and source-defined monetary unit.
indicators.unit: current national currency or USD, source-defined
indicators.calculation_method: Use UNIDO INDSTAT Rev. 4 manufacturing value-added observations for country-year comparisons. Apply no cross-country conversion beyond the source-defined series until peer-basket and currency methodology are approved.

version_history.definition: UNIDO INDSTAT Rev. 4 manufacturing value added under ISIC Rev. 4.
version_history.methodology: UNIDO INDSTAT Rev. 4; official national and regional statistical sources harmonised to ISIC Rev. 4.
version_history.comparability_status: Country-year coverage varies; final peer basket methodology remains unresolved.

indicators.name: Manufacturing capacity utilisation, seasonally adjusted (OBICUS)
indicators.definition: Seasonally adjusted aggregate capacity utilisation in India's manufacturing sector as published by the Reserve Bank of India from the quarterly OBICUS survey.

baseline.preferred_reference: Q1:2014-15 or latest valid pre-policy quarter
baseline.availability: OBICUS series begins Q1:2008-09 according to RBI seasonality documentation

indicators.calculation_method: Use the RBI-published seasonally adjusted capacity utilisation series. Retain the published raw CU as a companion diagnostic and never replace CU with CU-SA in source records. RBI calculates CU-SA using X13-ARIMA-SEATS; preserve the source methodology and any stated outlier treatment.

version_history.definition: RBI-published seasonally adjusted capacity utilisation of manufacturing companies from OBICUS.
version_history.numerator: not separately published as a standalone aggregate numerator in the indicator record; RBI estimates CU from reported production relative to installed capacity
version_history.denominator: installed capacity reported by participating manufacturing companies
version_history.methodology: RBI OBICUS quarterly survey; CU estimated from survey responses; CU-SA calculated using X13-ARIMA-SEATS with source-defined treatment of exceptional periods.
version_history.comparability_status: Comparable with adjustment; retain raw CU and CU-SA separately, preserve survey-panel and methodology notes, and do not treat OBICUS as a census of total manufacturing.

indicators.name: Registered manufacturing GVA per person engaged
indicators.definition: Gross Value Added per person engaged in factories covered by the Annual Survey of Industries, using the source-published national or State ratio for the reference year.
indicators.unit: ₹ per person engaged, source-defined current prices

baseline.availability: official ASI 2013-14 release and subsequent historical releases

indicators.calculation_method: Use the published ASI GVA per person engaged ratio where available. Do not recompute from rounded aggregate GVA and persons-engaged values when the source publishes the direct ratio. Treat the measure as nominal and do not interpret it as real productivity growth without an approved deflation method.

version_history.definition: Published ASI gross value added per person engaged for registered organised manufacturing factories.
version_history.denominator: source-published total persons engaged in ASI-covered factories
version_history.methodology: MoSPI Annual Survey of Industries published structural ratio; 2013-14 official release reports GVA per person engaged directly.
version_history.comparability_status: Comparable with adjustment; registered organised manufacturing coverage only, nominal price basis, and ASI frame/classification changes must be preserved. Not a total-manufacturing or real labour-productivity measure.

indicators.name: Manufacturing-product merchandise exports
indicators.definition: Value of India's merchandise exports classified as manufacturing products under the approved versioned HS-to-Manufacturing mapping.

baseline.preferred_reference: 2013-14 subject to source vintage and HS-edition coverage

indicators.calculation_method: Aggregate only HS lines classified IN_SCOPE under MFG-TRADE-MAP-1.0 for the applicable HS edition. Preserve trade valuation, HS edition, source vintage and mapping version. Exclude MIXED and UNRESOLVED lines from the core aggregate.

version_history.definition: Merchandise exports in HS lines mapped to manufacturing products under MFG-TRADE-MAP-1.0.
version_history.numerator: sum of export value for included manufacturing-product HS lines
version_history.methodology: Versioned ITC (HS) to manufacturing-product mapping; activity reference is NIC 2008 Section C, Divisions 10-33, with merchandise operational subset excluding non-goods activity concepts.
version_history.comparability_status: Product-based trade measure; includes recorded re-exports unless a reproducible source-level exclusion exists; not domestic-origin manufacturing exports.

indicators.name: Manufacturing-product merchandise imports
indicators.definition: Value of India's merchandise imports classified as manufacturing products under the approved versioned HS-to-Manufacturing mapping.

baseline.preferred_reference: 2013-14 subject to source vintage and HS-edition coverage

indicators.calculation_method: Aggregate only HS lines classified IN_SCOPE under MFG-TRADE-MAP-1.0 for the applicable HS edition. Preserve trade valuation, HS edition, source vintage and mapping version. Exclude MIXED and UNRESOLVED lines from the core aggregate.

version_history.definition: Merchandise imports in HS lines mapped to manufacturing products under MFG-TRADE-MAP-1.0.
version_history.numerator: sum of import value for included manufacturing-product HS lines
version_history.methodology: Versioned ITC (HS) to manufacturing-product mapping; activity reference is NIC 2008 Section C, Divisions 10-33, with merchandise operational subset excluding non-goods activity concepts.
version_history.comparability_status: Product-based trade measure; includes recorded re-imports unless a reproducible source-level exclusion exists; not manufacturing-sector import dependence.

indicators.name: Manufacturing-product import dependence
indicators.definition: Share of apparent domestic consumption of the mapped manufacturing-product universe supplied by imports, where apparent domestic consumption equals compatible domestic product output plus imports minus exports for the same HS product universe, period and valuation basis.

baseline.preferred_reference: 2013-14 subject to compatible domestic product-output coverage

indicators.calculation_method: Imports / (compatible domestic manufacturing-product output + imports - exports) * 100. Indicator is registered as PROVISIONAL. No observations may be loaded until a compatible domestic product-output dataset and valuation/mapping alignment are verified. Manufacturing GVA is not an acceptable denominator.

version_history.definition: Imports as a share of apparent domestic consumption for the same mapped manufacturing-product universe.
version_history.denominator: compatible domestic manufacturing-product output + manufacturing-product imports - manufacturing-product exports
version_history.methodology: Versioned HS-to-Manufacturing mapping under MFG-TRADE-MAP-1.0; compatible domestic product-output source remains a prerequisite for observations.
version_history.comparability_status: PROVISIONAL. Do not use manufacturing GVA as denominator. No observation or score until compatible domestic product-output evidence is established.
